title: AffrescoUI Package
description: A shared version of an app, in one file ending in .affresco.json: the version's source document, what turns it back into the release it was made from, and (kind "app") that release's files. A package is untrusted input: installing one is a proposal the person reviews and accepts, limited by the capabilities they grant. Specification: SCREEN_FORMAT.md, "Apps: app.json", and modules/format/src/packages/README.md. Limits: the file at most 16 MiB, 1024 files of at most 4 MiB each.

kind.description: "changes": a version of an app the person has; "app": also the base app's files, in base.files.

description.description: What the person wrote about the version.

author.description: A name the person typed: a claim, not a proof (a signature is the proof).

engine.description: The AffrescoUI release that wrote the package.

base.description: The release the version was made from.

release.description: Its app's release (app.json's release), if it has one.

notation.description: The notation its source document is written in.

tree.description: The SHA-256 of its source document's canonical JSON (RFC 8785).

delta.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) of add, remove and replace operations that turns document into the base's source document.

files.description: For a package of kind "app": the base app's folder, each file by its path in it.

state.description: The state keys the version adds, with their first values.

assets.description: The bytes of the assets the version adds, by name (VERSION_CONTROL.md, "Assets").

proof.description: The scenarios the version passes, as a change set's proof.

value.description: The Ed25519 signature of the package's canonical JSON without its signature, base64url.

signature.description: Optional, as a feature's: shown in the review and checked against the trusted publishers the person keeps.

release.description: Three numbers, as a feature's release ("1.2.0").

path.description: A file inside the app's folder: relative, no ".." part, '/' between parts.

base64.description: Bytes as base64 (RFC 4648, section 4), checked when read: a pattern is not matched against text this long.

file.description: A file's content: {"text"} for UTF-8 text, {"data"} for other bytes as base64; at most 4 MiB.

asset.description: An asset: its media type, and its content as text or base64 data.

operation.description: One JSON Patch operation: move, copy and test are not used.
